systems.name: Customs Clearance Operations
systems.status_detail: Taiwan Customs has scheduled a broad operational-host shutdown for 13 September 2026, 12:00–19:30 local time.

systems.name: Electronic-to-Mobile System
systems.status_detail: The 2026 Bureau of Customs memorandum index is monitored for new MISTG E2M System Advisories. This is bulletin monitoring, not a continuous heartbeat.

events.title: Taiwan customs operational host scheduled shutdown
events.summary: Taiwan Customs will shut down its customs operational host on 13 September from 12:00 to 19:30 local time for an uninterruptible-power-system exercise.
events.operational_impact: The Customs-Port-Trade Single Window, online customs declaration and payment services, message processing/exchange, advance cargo information, tariff lookup, mobile customs platform and bonded smart-platform services will be suspended. The IoT monitoring platform stops from 11:00; the inbound passenger baggage system remains operational.
events.workaround: Complete time-sensitive declarations and messages before the window. Services may return early if the exercise finishes ahead of schedule.
